punchline: Brown says everyone she found able to feel joy practiced gratitude, because joy arrives together with the fear of losing it.
thirty_sec: In The Gifts of Imperfection, Brené Brown describes foreboding joy: when a good moment arrives, people feel fear of losing it, like a parent over a sleeping child. In her research, everyone able to truly feel joy practiced gratitude regularly. Instead of rehearsing disaster, they name what they are grateful for. We can't numb the dark feelings without numbing joy.
